data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 雨停前的屋檐
data.description: 便利店的屋檐下，雪菜把还未打开的伞靠在身边，等雨势小一点再走。
data.action: standing under an awning with a closed umbrella
data.promptProse: Sheltered beneath the glass awning of a flower shop during a sudden summer downpour, Setsuna holds a closed umbrella at her side, extending an open palm to catch sparkling raindrops. The scent of wet asphalt and blooming gardenias fills the air, while sunlight breaking through storm clouds creates a brilliant double rainbow above the glistening street.
